ApplySoundAndRemap: Apply the saved sound and button settings when a game starts (called from DiaryStartLoadConfirm and DiaryNewGameStart). Clears $0B04 and menuModeFlag. Sound: $0B24 = 0 sends SPC command $91 (stereo), nonzero sends $90 (mono) through APUIO0. Buttons: $0B26 = 0 (Type 1) sets remapA = $8000, remapB = $4000, remapX = 0, remapY = $0040; nonzero (Type 2) only clears remapX and leaves the other remaps unchanged.
BootLogoInit: Entry, both visits. Display set-up (bit 14 of displayModeFlags, black backdrop, FastROM, TM = OBJ only, joypad mask), then STAT78 bit 4 decides: 60 Hz falls through to BootLogoNtsc, 50 Hz jumps to BootLogoPalLockout.
BootLogoNtsc: NTSC path. Centres the actor (X +8), then splits on event flag $10: set = second visit (BootLogoSecondPhase); clear = first visit: Y -16, animation #01 for 2 passes, set the flag, reload scene $FB, Die.
BootLogoPalLockout: PAL lockout screen. Copies the first 8 colours of pal_ending_comet into staging colours 0 to 7, forces colour 0 to black, draws the region warning (boot_title_strings) on BG3 and sets TM = $04 (BG3 only). The actor then yields every frame at the SetEntryHere / RTL pair and never leaves. Only the warning is drawn: PUSH START and the copyright string belong to the title scene.
BootLogoSecondPhase: Second visit: animation #00 (the emblem logo) for 2 passes of 60 ticks, clear event flag $10, QueueMapChange to scene $FC (title screen) with the same $1100 camera-bounds operand, Die.
debug_man: Actor definition: sprite index 2, flags 0, header byte $10. The body is the single label DebugManEntry.
DebugManEntry: One-shot entry: solid NPC, interact handler = DebugManInteract, SetEntryHere, RTL. Nothing runs afterwards.
DebugManInteract: Talk handler: HP and max HP := 40, STR and DEF := 127, abilityBitmask := $FF, greeting, then the level 1 menu (table DebugMenuTable1). DialogueOptions resumes the script at the chosen table entry, so the handler never returns here; the leaf or DebugManQuit does the RTL.
DebugManQuit: Prints 'Bye bye!' and returns. Target of B (entry 0) at every level and of row 1 at level 7.
DebugMenuLevel2: Level 2 page and menu: Others / Itorie / HOME OF MOON TRIBE / Underground castle (dialogstring_0BF05C, table DebugMenuTable2).
DebugMenuLevel3: Level 3 page and menu: Others / City of Euro / Native's Village / Desert Village Dao (dialogstring_0BF095, table DebugMenuTable3).
DebugMenuLevel4: Level 4 page and menu: Others / INCA / HANANOMIYAKO / DAIYAMONDO (dialogstring_0BF0C3, table DebugMenuTable4).
DebugMenuLevel5: Level 5 page and menu: Others / Sky Garden / Palace / Mu (dialogstring_0BF0EC, table DebugMenuTable5).
DebugMenuLevel6: Level 6 page and menu: Others / Angel Village / Native's Village / Dao (dialogstring_0BF10D, table DebugMenuTable6).
DebugMenuLevel7: Level 7 (last) page and menu: Quit / Pyramid / Watermia / Ankor Wat (dialogstring_0BF135, table DebugMenuTable7).

Named scenes: $01, $0B, $12, $15, $1E, $26, $28, $34, $3D, $40, $42, $4C, $51, $54, $56, $5A, $60, $62, $6C, $7C, $85, $86, $88, $99, $A1, $A3, $A7, $AC, $B6, $B8, $BB, $C3, $CC, $E0, $E3; all others use the default entry.
diary_entry_underground_tunnel: Underground Tunnel: scene $12; camera ($0080, $02B0), the same as Edward Prison.
diary_erase_confirm_table: DialogueOptions targets, indexed by the returned value (index + 1, 0 = cancel): cancel and 'No' -> DiaryEraseDecline, 'Yes' -> DiaryEraseExecute.
diary_erase_slot_name_table: Slot-name strings for the erase prompt, indexed by $0D94.
diary_erase_stat_line_table: Pointer table indexed by $0D94: the three slot stat-line strings (dialogstring_0BF4C3 / 0BF4EA / 0BF511) for the erase prompt.
diary_tab_dispatch_table: SwitchCase targets for DiaryTabConfirm, indexed by the tab cursor: 0 = Start Journey, 1 = Erase, 2 = Copy, 3 = Change Snd/Buttons.
DiaryAwaitButtonRelease_noref: Unreferenced pause helper: if A is down ($0080 in joypadRaw) wait for it to be released, then for a fresh press, then for the release again, running the diary VBlank handler each frame - a press-A-to-pause toggle.
DiaryCameraPan: Camera pan toward the highlighted slot's map location, one call per frame (called with COP CallNear). The slot's scene ID ($0D74,Y) indexes diary_entry_table; the entry is a name string ended by $CA followed by two words, the camera target X and Y. |dx| / |dy| and their signs go to $7F100C / $7F100E and animScratch, then a Bresenham walk moves cameraTargetX/Y one pixel per step along the longer axis, $free101C steps per frame (12 from the slot loop). Mid-pan it re-arms itself with SetEntryHere; when the target is reached (or was already there) RestoreSavedPtr returns to the CallNear caller.
DiaryClearAllCursors:
Clear all cursor positions in a sub-menu — writes blank tiles to every selectable row.
Wraps the cursor index within the valid range using the count from diary_cursor_menu_table[0].
DiaryClearCursor: Clear cursor — writes blank tile $2040 at the cursor's VRAM position to erase the highlight.
DiaryCopyCancel: B on the source list: consume the press, clear the text and return to the main menu.
DiaryCopyExecute: A on the target slot: copy the source slot's whole 512-byte SRAM page (data plus both checksums) to the target with the RAM block-move stub at $0402 (MVN, banks $30 -> $30), move the cursor to the new slot, rescan the slots and show the source list again.
DiaryCopySourceConfirm: A on the source slot: ignored when the slot is empty. Otherwise find the first empty slot (scene ID 0), put the target cursor ($0D96) on it and enter the target loop.
DiaryCopySourceLoop: Source-slot loop: prints 'Move which Diary?' (the string that heads the Copy tab), redraws the stats and the legend, then polls Up / Down / A / B.
DiaryCopyTab:
Copy Trip Diary tab — copy a diary slot's SRAM data to an empty slot.
First checks if all 3 slots are occupied — if so, shows "Diary not empty" and returns.
Otherwise enters source slot selection, then target slot selection (skips occupied slots).
Uses SRAM block copy (JSR $0402) to transfer 512 bytes between slot offsets.
DiaryCopyTargetCancel: B on the target list: clear the target cursor ($FFFF) and go back to the source list.
DiaryCopyTargetDown: Target cursor down: steps forward (wrapping over 3 slots) until it lands on an empty slot other than the source.
DiaryCopyTargetUp: Target cursor up: steps back (wrapping over 3 slots) until it lands on an empty slot other than the source.
DiaryCursorApplyMove: Apply a move: wrap $1A (DiaryClearAllCursors blanks every position), reset the blink counter, consume the D-pad press and play SFX #10.
DiaryCursorCancel: Cancel: consume the press, return A = $FFFF with carry set.
DiaryCursorConfirm: Confirm: draw the cursor, SFX #11, consume the press, return A = $1A with carry set.
DiaryCursorNav_noref: Unreferenced BG3 cursor engine entry (DP $14 = menu index into diary_cursor_menu_table, $18 = blink counter, $1A = cursor position). A confirms, $0020 cancels, Up / Down move by one, Left / Right move by two when the menu index is below 2. Returns A = position with carry clear while choosing, carry set once confirmed (or cancelled with A = $FFFF).
DiaryDigitDisplay_noref: Unreferenced debug display: while controller 2's B ($8000 in $E0) is held, show $DE as BCD digit sprites (ComposeDigitSprites_AtCursor) at the BG1 scroll + ($10, $70).
DiaryDrawCursorHighlight: Draw cursor highlight — writes tile $202B (highlight arrow) at the cursor's VRAM position.
DiaryEraseCancel: B on the erase list: clear the text and return to the main menu.
DiaryEraseDecline: No / cancel: consume the press and return to the Erase tab. The vanilla button-remap restore that follows in the line-tracked text is stripped from the plain extraction by transforms.json.
DiaryEraseExecute: Yes: erase SFX #13, ClearSaveSlot for the slot in $0D94, wait 30 ticks (WaitByte #1D), rescan the slots, clear the text and return to the Erase list. The vanilla remap-restore stub at the top is stripped from the plain extraction by transforms.json.
DiaryEraseInputLoop: Erase slot list: Up / Down move (shared handlers with the Snd/Buttons slot picker), A selects, B returns to the main menu.
DiaryEraseSelectLoop: Redraw the Erase title, stats and legend; slot cursor := 0.
DiaryEraseSlotConfirm: A on a slot. An empty slot is cleared at once with ClearSaveSlot (no prompt). A used slot opens the 'Erase diary? No / Yes' prompt: the slot name via diary_erase_slot_name_table, its HP / STR / DEF via diary_erase_stat_line_table, and COP DialogueOptions with the targets in diary_erase_confirm_table.
DiaryEraseSlotDown: Slot cursor down (wraps 2 -> 0); shared with the Snd/Buttons slot picker.
DiaryEraseSlotUp: Slot cursor up (wraps 0 -> 2); shared with the Snd/Buttons slot picker.
DiaryEraseTab:
Erase Trip Diary tab — select a diary slot and optionally delete it.
Shows slot stats before confirming. Empty slots are erased immediately via ClearSaveSlot.
Occupied slots show a yes/no confirmation prompt with stat preview.
DiaryJoypadFilter_noref: Unreferenced debug input filter for controller 2 ($E0 = pad word, $E2 = held mask): keeps only newly pressed buttons in $E0 and, on a fresh X ($0040), toggles bit 3 ($0008) of the player actor's $10 field.
DiaryMainMenuEntry:
Main menu re-entry — redraws the 4-option menu and enters the tab selection loop.
Navigation: Up/Down cycle through 4 tabs ($0D98), A confirms, dispatches via SwitchCase.
DiaryMenuClearVram: Clear VRAM buffer — wrapper that preserves registers across ClearVramBufferFull call.
DiaryMenuInit: Scene $FA actor entry: black backdrop and no layers, all three cursors set to none ($FFFF), display configured as described in the block note, main-menu text and button legend printed, the three SRAM slots scanned, then a poll of worldReadyFlag until the scene is ready, after which it joins the tab loop at loc_0BE2D0.
DiaryMenuVBlankHandler: Copy of the engine's VBlankWaitAndJoypad: waits for VBlank (RDNMI), uploads the Mode 7 registers when scrollModeFlags bit 3 is set, honours joypadInject, builds joypadRemapped from the D-pad plus each remap word (remapStart ... remapR), publishes it to joypadCurrent / joypadRaw, and applies the consumption mask, the 12-frame auto-repeat on joypadMaskInv and joypadMaskStd. Its only caller is the unreferenced DiaryAwaitButtonRelease_noref, so the live menu never runs it.
DiaryNewGameCancel: B on the arrangement screen: row cursor off, restore the slot cursor from $0D94 and show the slot list again.
DiaryNewGameSettingsLoop: Loop of the 'Arrangement OK?' screen: A / Left / Right act on the row (DiarySettingsToggle), Up / Down move the row cursor, B goes back to the slot list.
DiaryNewGameStart: New game confirmed on the arrangement screen: store the sound / button settings in $0B24 / $0B26, apply them (ApplySoundAndRemap), queue scene $08 (its spawn list holds sc08_priest, sc08_lance, sc08_seth and sc08_erik) at ($50,$A0), clear the playerFlags bits set by the menu and Die.
DiaryReadJoy2_noref: Unreferenced: read controller 2 (JOY2L/JOY2H, $421A/$421B) into $E0 for the debug routines above.
DiaryRenderSlotStats:
Render diary slot stats — for each non-empty slot, reads the saved HP/STR/DEF values,
converts them to BCD via FormatBcdNumber, and prints them using the stat display templates.
DiaryScanSramLoop: Per-slot loop: $24 = slot (2 down to 0), X = slot * 512.
DiaryScanSramSlots: Scan the three SRAM slots into the diary state block. The scene-ID, HP and DEF fields ($0D74-$0D84) are zeroed first (the second block of three stores repeats $0D80-$0D84, so the STR fields $0D86-$0D8A are never zeroed; they are only shown for slots with a nonzero scene ID, which overwrites them). Reads $306000 (last-used slot, reset to 0 when >= 3) into $0D8C. For slots 2, 1, 0 it recomputes both checksums and, when they match, copies sourceSceneId ($0B12), playerMaxHp ($0ACA), playerDef ($0ADC) and playerStr ($0ADE) from the slot page; $26 collects one validity bit per slot (bit n = slot n).
DiarySettingsDown: Row cursor down (rows 0-2, wraps); shared with the arrangement screen.
DiarySettingsToggle: A / Left / Right on the arrangement screen. Row 0 (Start Journey): only A acts (loc_0BE4E7 -> DiaryNewGameStart). Row 1 (Sound): toggle $0D90 and redraw its text. Row 2 (Button Type): toggle $0D8E (loc_0BE4C5) and redraw its legend.
DiarySettingsUp: Row cursor up (rows 0-2, wraps); shared by the arrangement screen and the Snd/Buttons editor.
DiarySndBtnCancel: B on the slot picker: clear the text and return to the main menu.
DiarySndBtnEditCancel: B in the editor: discard the edit and return to the slot picker (DiarySndBtnTab).
DiarySndBtnEditLoop: Editor loop: A / Left / Right act on the row (DiarySndBtnOptionToggle), Up / Down move the row cursor ($0D98, rows 0-2), B abandons the edit.
DiarySndBtnOptionToggle: A / Left / Right in the editor. Row 1 toggles sound ($0D90), row 2 toggles the button type ($0D8E) (loc_0BE7CC); on row 0 (End Changes) A saves (loc_0BE7EE).
DiarySndBtnSaveConfirm: Save: write both settings into the slot's SRAM page (WriteSramSettings), recompute both checksums and store them at $3063FC / $3063FE + slot*512, then redraw the slot picker with the cursor back on that slot.
DiarySndBtnSlotConfirm: A on a slot: plays SFX #12; an empty slot (scene ID 0) is ignored. Otherwise remember the slot in $0D94, load its sound / button settings (ReadSramSettings) and show the editor (End Changes / Sound / Button Type).
DiarySndBtnSlotLoop: Slot picker of the Snd/Buttons tab; it shares the Erase tab's Up/Down handlers. A opens the editor for a used slot, B returns to the main menu.
DiarySndBtnTab:
Change Snd/Buttons tab — toggle stereo/mono sound and button layout assignment.
After confirming, saves settings to the active save slot's SRAM and recomputes checksums.
DiaryStartCancel: B on the slot list: clear the text and return to the main menu.
DiaryStartJourney:
Start Journey tab — diary slot selection, save validation, and game load.
Displays 3 diary slots with HP/STR/DEF stats. On confirm, validates the SRAM checksum,
loads event flags, and transitions to scene $E6 (Dark Space) to resume gameplay.
Camera pan animation (DiaryCameraPan) scrolls to the selected slot's world position.
DiaryStartLoadConfirm: Load confirmed — validate SRAM, apply settings, and transition to Dark Space.
DiaryStartSlotDown: Slot cursor down (wraps 2 -> 0); plays the cursor SFX and consumes the press.
DiaryStartSlotLoop: Slot-list loop of Start Journey: every frame set the pan speed, run DiaryCameraPan toward the highlighted slot's location, re-arm this loop, then poll Up/Down (move), A (load) and B (back).
DiaryStartSlotUp: Slot cursor up (wraps 0 -> 2); plays the cursor SFX and consumes the press.
DiaryTabConfirm: Tab confirm — dispatches to the selected tab handler via SwitchCase on $0D98.
DiaryTabCursorDown: Tab cursor Down — increment with wraparound (3→0).
DiaryTabCursorUp: Tab cursor Up — decrement with wraparound (0→3).
DiaryTabSelectLoop: Tab loop: redraw the legend, re-enter every frame, Up/Down move the tab cursor (which drives the narrow window band), A confirms.
DiaryUnused24B_noref: Unreferenced bytes extracted as code with the wrong register width. Read with 8-bit A they are LDA $E1 / BIT #$40 / BEQ (to the RTL) / LDA #$04 / JSL $82:81C9 (WaitFrames) / RTL: holding Y ($4000 in the $E0 word) on controller 2 adds a 4-frame wait (slow motion). An overrides.json M = 1 entry at 782923 would extract it correctly (renames ledger R-I057-4).
FormatBcdNumber:
BCD number formatter — converts a 16-bit value to packed hundreds:tens:ones format.
Returns carry clear on success, carry set if value ≥ 1000 (overflow).
Output: high byte = hundreds (×$100), low byte = tens (×$10) | ones.
Values 500+ get pre-subtracted 500 with hundreds starting at 5.
func_0BEC06_noref:
Cursor navigation handler for sub-menus — handles D-pad, L/R paging, A confirm, B/Y cancel.
Returns carry set + selection index on A press, carry set + $FFFF on cancel.
Auto-toggles cursor visibility on a 16-frame blink cycle ($18 counter).
IsNotLoromAddress: Carry SET for a value below 0x8000, carry CLEAR for 0x8000 and up. The caller treats carry set as 'not a LoROM address, skip it', so only operands of 0x8000 or more are shown.

ReadSramSettings:
Read sound/button settings from SRAM for the selected slot.
Extracts $0B24 (sound mode) and $0B26 (button layout) from the slot's save data.
TitleCometSpriteActor: Title comet sprite actor (spawned by TitleIntroInit at ($80,$50)). Runs animation #00 for 240 loop cycles in place, then 64 loop cycles with X speed 2 (StageSpriteLoopMoveX), waits 60 ticks (WaitByte #3B), switches TM to $16 and parks on SetEntryHere. Its frames come from spm_title_actors.
TitleIntroInit: Actor entry: set the display flags, load the palettes (pal_title over CGRAM colours 0-31, then pal_ending_comet over colours 0-7), spawn the comet, set TM = $10, then run the timed text sequence and the idle wait that ends in the queued change to the prologue scene.
TitlePaletteStep_noref: Palette-animation stub: PaletteStart #2D (45 decimal), one PaletteStep, then Die. No spawn or pointer to it exists anywhere in extracted/ (UNVERIFIED-RUNTIME whether anything reaches it).
TitleStartDelayedInit: Title-scene variant: suppress the buttons, wait 540 ticks (WaitWord #$021B), then join the shared poll loop.
TitleStartPollInit: Prologue-scene variant (spawned as sFC_title_start_poll): suppress the buttons and poll immediately.
TitleStartPollLoop: Shared poll loop: re-enter every frame; Start (read from joypadRaw) -> TitleToDiaryTransition, otherwise RTL.
TitleToDiaryTransition: Start pressed: reset the transition parameters, queue the change to scene $FA (diary menu) at ($0100,$0370), yield one frame, run one VBlank sync with DP = $0000 (the actor's DP points at its slot, so it is swapped around the call), then keep the screen in force blank until the scene change takes over.
unused_particle_rain_spawner: Actor entry. Unreferenced. Loops forever spawning UnusedRainDropChild; the delay between spawns shrinks from 120 to 5 ticks.
UnusedRainDropChild: One raindrop: random X above the screen, random speed index; falls diagonally down-left and dies when Y reaches $0200 at the end of an animation pass.

WriteSramSettings:
Write sound/button settings to SRAM for the selected slot.
Stores $0D90 (sound mode) and $0D8E (button layout) into the slot's save data.
